user_story: As a user, I want logging out twice in a row to not cause an error so that the logout action is idempotent.

positive.title: Verify user is logged out successfully without error when logging out twice consecutively.
steps: Log in to the application with valid credentials.
Verify the user is logged out and redirected to the login page.
Verify there is no error and the user remains on the login page.
positive.expected_result: User is logged out without any errors, and second logout attempt has no adverse effect.

negative.title: Verify no error message is displayed when user attempts to log out without being logged in.
steps: Ensure the user is not logged in (open a new session or browser tab).
Attempt to access the logout URL directly or click on the 'Logout' button on the login screen.
negative.expected_result: No error message is displayed, and user remains on the login screen.

edge.title: Verify system behavior when session expires and user clicks 'Logout' button.
steps: Log in to the application with valid credentials.
Leave the session inactive to allow it to expire naturally (or simulate session expiration).
Once session is expired, click on the 'Logout' button.
edge.expected_result: No error is displayed. User is either redirected to login page or remains on the current page without session.
